comments.content: The comment says 'module whose name only matches the user specified word in the middle' but the logic checks `completionText.Contains('.')` and then validates the substring after the last dot. This filters out modules where the *last segment* doesn't match the pattern, not modules where the match occurs in the middle of the full name. For example, 'gmo power' with completionText 'Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility' would have last segment 'Utility' which doesn't match 'power', so it gets filtered - but the comment implies the issue is matching 'power' in the middle of 'PowerShell'. Consider clarifying the comment to match the actual logic: it filters modules where the final dotted segment doesn't match the user's input pattern.
